content.shloka: Once upon a time, Goddess Parvati created Ganesha from sandalwood paste.
content.meaning: This story teaches devotion, obedience, and divine protection.

content.shloka: Lord Shiva accepted Ganesha as his son and granted him the status of first worship.
content.meaning: This symbolizes acceptance and supreme compassion.
